home.intro: Thoughtful, individual tattoos — from considered custom pieces to little designs that mean a lot. Specialising in black and grey tattooing.

about.heading: Meet your artist.
about.name: Hey! I'm Iona.
about.paragraph1: I'm an independent tattoo artist based in Berwick-upon-Tweed. I love creating tattoos that feel personal to the person wearing them, whether that's a custom idea or a favourite flash design.
about.paragraph2: My work focuses primarily on black and grey, with an interest in bold designs, illustrative detail and pieces with a little character.

services.title: Custom tattoos
services.description: One-off designs developed around your ideas, placement and personal style.

services.title: Flash designs
services.description: Choose from available designs, or keep an eye out for new flash releases.
